alerts.subject: [C10-MED] 10y Real Yield rising: 2.42% (+53bp off 90d-low)
alerts.body:
Series:   REAL10 (DFII10)
Date:     2026-08-28
Current:  2.42%
90d low:  1.89%
Move:     +53bp off 90d-low (fire ≥ +40bp)

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:
The 10-year TIPS-derived real yield jumped to 2.42% on 2026-08-28, up 0.53pp from its trailing-90-day low of 1.89%, crossing C10's 2x-trigger threshold for a HIGH escalation.

内容:
10年期 TIPS 隐含实际收益率在 2026-08-28 升至 2.42%，比过去 90 天低点 1.89% 高出 0.53 个百分点，触发了 C10 的 2 倍地板，升级为 HIGH。

Why it matters:
Real yields this high raise the discount rate applied to long-duration AI capex bets and make the risk-free alternative to speculative growth assets much more attractive. A sustained move here pressures the same high-multiple AI names that a credit or neocloud fuse would hit, just through the rates channel instead of the credit channel.

影响:
实际利率这么高，会拉高对 AI 长周期资本开支的折现率，同时让无风险资产比高估值成长股更有吸引力。这个信号走的是利率渠道，跟信用或 neocloud 引信打的是同一批高估值 AI 股票，只是路径不同。

Anthropic IPO Could Open AI Listings Floodgates: Madrona

The IA40 list from Madrona is back, spotlighting the private companies shaping the next phase of AI. Matt McIlwain, managing director at Madrona, explains how the list is assembled, why OpenAI, Anthropic and Databricks dominate AI fundraising, and how a successful Anthropic IPO could open the door for a new wave of public offerings in 2027. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:

彭博 Bloomberg Tech 节目讨论了 Madrona 的 IA40 私营 AI 公司榜单，提到 OpenAI、Anthropic 和 Databricks 主导私募 AI 融资，并推测 Anthropic 若成功 IPO，可能带动 2027 年更多 AI 公司上市。

Why it matters:
This is speculative commentary about a future IPO, not a disclosed metric or filing — it's exactly the kind of low-signal AI-fundraising chatter the C3 MED tier is built to catch, with no burn-rate or filing data to act on.

影响:

Real yields near cycle highs raise the discount rate applied to AI capex's distant payback and tighten financial conditions broadly — this is C10's early-warning leg, not yet at the 2x-trigger HIGH escalation.

影响:
实际收益率逼近周期高位，会拉高 AI capex 那种远期回本项目的贴现率，同时收紧整体金融条件——这是 C10 的早期预警腿，还没到 2 倍触发线对应的 HIGH 级别。

US core PCE inflation rose to 3.34% year-over-year for the period ending 2026-07-01, exceeding the 3.0% threshold.

截至 2026-07-01，美国核心 PCE 通胀同比升至 3.34%，超过 3.0% 的阈值。

This confirms inflation is running hot on the Fed's preferred gauge, reducing room for rate cuts and reinforcing the higher-for-longer rate regime that pressures growth/AI-capex valuations. It corroborates the CPI print from the same window, strengthening the macro-tightening thesis behind C8.

影响:
这条数据证实通胀在美联储最看重的指标上依然偏热，降息空间因此收窄，利率维持高位的局面对成长股和 AI capex 估值不利。它和同期的 CPI 数据相互印证，加强了 C8 背后的宏观收紧逻辑。

What this means:
The 10-year real (TIPS) yield jumped from a trailing-90-day low of 1.89% to 2.38% as of 2026-08-24, a 0.49pp rise.

内容:
10 年期实际（TIPS）收益率从近 90 天低点 1.89% 升至 2.38%（截至 2026-08-24），涨了 0.49 个百分点。

Why it matters:
Rising real yields raise the discount rate applied to long-duration AI-capex cash flows and make debt-funded buildouts more expensive to service, squeezing the valuation multiples that justify current spend. This is the C10 liquidity thermometer flashing tighter financial conditions, not a fuse by itself.

影响:
实际收益率上升会提高 AI capex 这类长久期现金流的折现率，也让债务融资的建设项目还款成本更高，压缩支撑当前支出的估值倍数。这是 C10 流动性温度计显示金融条件收紧，本身不是引信。

alerts.subject: [C10-MED] 10y Real Yield rising: 2.40% (+51bp off 90d-low)
alerts.body:
Series:   REAL10 (DFII10)
Date:     2026-08-21
Current:  2.40%
90d low:  1.89%
Move:     +51bp off 90d-low (fire ≥ +40bp)

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:
The 10-year TIPS real yield jumped to 2.40% on 2026-08-21, up 0.51pp from its trailing-90-day low of 1.89%.

内容:
10 年期 TIPS 实际收益率在 2026-08-21 升至 2.40%，比过去 90 天低点 1.89% 高出 0.51 个百分点。

Why it matters:
Rising real yields raise the discount rate on long-duration AI-capex cash flows and tighten financial conditions broadly — a real-yield spike this size crosses C10's 2x-trigger threshold, pushing severity from MED toward HIGH.

影响:
实际收益率上升会提高 AI capex 这类长久期现金流的贴现率，也会整体收紧金融条件——这次涨幅已经达到 C10 的 2 倍触发阈值，严重度从 MED 往 HIGH 走。

alerts.subject: [C3-CRITICAL] The Rising Price of the AI Race | Bloomberg Tech 8/24/2026
alerts.body:
Severity:  CRITICAL
Feed:      https://feeds.bloomberg.com/technology/news.rss
Published: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 18:30:00 GMT
Link:      https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2026-08-24/bloomberg-tech-8-24-2026-video

The Rising Price of the AI Race | Bloomberg Tech 8/24/2026

Bloomberg’s Ed Ludlow breaks down what to expect from Nvidia's earnings this week, this as Bloomberg reports Nvidia customers have been notified about price hikes. Plus, SoftBank plans a record $6.3 billion retail bond sale to raise funds for its investment commitments to OpenAI. And, Alibaba raises $10.2 billion to take the lead in the global AI race in what was Hong Kong's biggest follow-on offering. (Source: Bloomberg)

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:
Bloomberg's daily AI-race roundup covers three items: Nvidia customer price hikes ahead of earnings, SoftBank's planned $6.3B retail bond sale to fund OpenAI commitments, and Alibaba's $10.2B follow-on offering (Hong Kong's largest) to fund AI investment.

内容:
彭博的 AI 竞赛日报涵盖三件事：Nvidia 客户价格上调（财报前夕）、软银计划发行 63 亿美元零售债券为其对 OpenAI 的投资承诺融资，以及阿里巴巴以 102 亿美元完成香港史上最大规模的后续发售为 AI 投入融资。

Why it matters:
All three are financing-for-AI-capex signals stacking on the same day: Nvidia pricing power feeding through to customers, SoftBank raising retail debt specifically tied to OpenAI exposure, and Alibaba tapping equity markets at scale for AI. None is a stress signal by itself, but the clustering of debt/equity raises earmarked for AI spend is exactly the kind of financing-dependency backdrop the bubble-stress thesis watches.

影响:
这三条都是「为 AI capex 融资」的信号扎堆出现在同一天：Nvidia 的提价体现其对客户的定价权，软银发零售债专门对应 OpenAI 敞口，阿里巴巴则大规模动用股权市场为 AI 投入筹钱。单看任何一条都不算压力信号，但债权/股权融资集中投向 AI 支出这种搭子，正是 bubble-stress 论点要盯的「融资依赖」背景。

alerts.subject: [C3-CRITICAL] Alibaba Drops, SoftBank Bond Sale, Bitcoin Rally | Stock Movers
alerts.body:
Severity:  CRITICAL
Feed:      https://feeds.bloomberg.com/technology/news.rss
Published: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 14:26:32 GMT
Link:      https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2026-08-24/alibaba-drops-softbank-bond-sale-stock-movers-video

Alibaba Drops, SoftBank Bond Sale, Bitcoin Rally | Stock Movers

Today's biggest winners and losers in the stock market.

On this episode of Stock Movers:

- Alibaba (BABA) is tumbling after announcing a plan to raise about HK$80 billion ($10.2 billion) from a share sale. The share placement is expected to dilute earnings and hurt stock performance in the near term, analysts said. Meanwhile, the fundraising will help drive AI-led growth and the impact on earnings will be limited if the company can improve AI payoffs, they added. The tech and chip sectors are seeing a broader selloff globally.

- SoftBank (SFTBY) is moving on news it plans a record ¥1 trillion retail bond sale to raise funds for its investment commitments to OpenAI.

- Bitcoin (BTC) is continuing its rally. Spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds had their strongest weekly inflow in 10 months last week as the original cryptocurrency surged. (Source: Bloomberg)

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:
Bloomberg's Stock Movers roundup ties three separate moves together: Alibaba (BABA) is falling after unveiling a HK$80B (~$10.2B) share placement to fund AI growth, SoftBank (SFTBY) is planning a record ¥1T retail bond sale to cover its OpenAI investment commitments, and Bitcoin continues rallying on record spot-ETF inflows.

内容:
彭博 Stock Movers 栏目把三条消息放在一起播报：阿里巴巴 (BABA) 因宣布约 HK$80 亿（约 $10.2B）的股票配售用于 AI 增长而股价下跌，软银 (SFTBY) 计划发行创纪录的 ¥1 万亿零售债券以支付对 OpenAI 的投资承诺，比特币则在现货 ETF 创 10 个月最强单周净流入的带动下持续上涨。

Why it matters:
Two of the largest AI-capex backers are turning to dilutive equity (Alibaba) and debt (SoftBank) to keep funding commitments, which is exactly the strain-on-financing pattern the bubble-stress thesis watches for — capex outrunning organic cash generation. The BTC/crypto-inflow angle is unrelated noise bundled into the same segment, not a capex signal.

影响:
两大 AI 资本开支的重要出资方都在转向融资：阿里靠增发股票（会稀释每股收益），软银靠发债，都是为了填补对 AI 的投入缺口——这正是 bubble-stress 论点关注的「资本开支跑赢自身造血能力」的信号。比特币/加密资金流入那段和资本开支无关，只是同一节目里混进来的噪音。

ChatGPT Maker Said To Have Lost $39B Last Year: Here's How That Compares To Anthropic, SpaceX  Stocktwits ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── What this means: A news report claims leaked OpenAI financials show a $39B loss last year ahead of a potential IPO, comparing the figure to Anthropic and SpaceX. 内容: 一篇报道称泄露的 OpenAI 财务数据显示其去年亏损 $39B，报道将这个数字与 Anthropic、SpaceX 做了对比，背景是 OpenAI 可能 IPO。 Why it matters: An unverified $39B burn figure, if real, would be a step-change in OpenAI's cash-burn trajectory — the C3 thesis tracks OpenAI burn as the demand-side stress test for the whole AI-capex chain. But this is IPO speculation from a single outlet, not a filing or company disclosure, so treat it as noise until corroborated. 影响: 如果 $39B 的烧钱数字属实，那是 OpenAI 现金消耗的一次跳变——C3 这条线追踪的正是 OpenAI 的烧钱速度，作为整条 AI capex 链需求端压力的试金石。但这只是单一媒体的 IPO 前猜测，不是 filing 或公司披露，没有交叉验证前当噪音处理。

alerts.subject: [C3-CRITICAL] SoftBank Plans Record $6.3 Billion Retail Bond Sale in Japan
alerts.body:
Severity:  CRITICAL
Feed:      https://feeds.bloomberg.com/technology/news.rss
Published: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 00:16:25 GMT
Link:      https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-08-24/softbank-plans-record-1-trillion-retail-bond-offering-in-japan

SoftBank Plans Record $6.3 Billion Retail Bond Sale in Japan

SoftBank Group Corp. plans a record ¥1 trillion ($6.3 billion) retail bond sale by any issuer in Japan as the conglomerate raises funds for its investment commitments to OpenAI.

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:
SoftBank Group plans a record ¥1 trillion ($6.3B) domestic retail bond sale in Japan to fund its investment commitments to OpenAI.

内容:
软银集团计划在日本发行创纪录的 1 万亿日元（63 亿美元）零售债券，用于兑现对 OpenAI 的投资承诺。

Why it matters:
SoftBank is tapping retail debt markets — not cash on hand — to meet OpenAI funding obligations, pushing capital-raising risk onto Japanese retail bondholders. A record-size issuance signals the scale of committed capital is straining even SoftBank's balance sheet, reinforcing the thesis that OpenAI's capex needs are outrunning what conventional financing can absorb.

影响:
软银这次是靠零售债市场融资，不是动用自有现金，把筹资风险转嫁给了日本散户债权人。发行规模创纪录，说明对 OpenAI 的承诺资金规模已经大到连软银自己的资产负债表都吃紧，进一步印证 OpenAI 的资本开支需求正在超出常规融资渠道的承受能力。
